package.name: wojtek_structure_core
package.description:
ROS 2 driver for the Occipital Structure Core (ST02D-C), for the targeting camera of the wojtek_targeting experiment.
Publishes colour and depth with their camera_info and nothing else: no pointcloud, no registration, no IMU. The Structure SDK it builds against is closed-source and is NOT vendored here -- see the README for where to get it and how to point the build at it.
